items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: I called them all. Jack Holt, Sam Adams, Francis Whitby, Arthur Williams, me, Pete Jones, Eddie Anderson who played bass, then Debo Mills who played the drums, and Charlie Toran on piano.

ctx.x: So who else was in the King Oliver band besides MacTear?
I called them all. Jack Holt, Sam Adams, Francis Whitby, Arthur Williams, me, Pete Jones, Eddie Anderson who played bass, then Debo Mills who played the drums, and Charlie Toran on piano.
Dan Andrews on the string bass it says in here.
